title: Prepare the Biomancy Chamber
description: Gnarl's flesh-work needs a proper place in the Dark Tower. Establish a functioning Bio-Forge so the chamber can process living matter safely enough to be useful. This activates the Tower facility only; deeper Biomancy mastery remains in the dedicated discipline arc.
description_completed: The Dark Tower now has an operational Biomancy chamber centered on a working Bio-Forge. Decomposers, Digesters, Bio-Labs, Injectors, Cradles and deeper flesh-work remain part of Biomancy's own progression rather than formal Tower Restoration.

prerequisites.name: Establish the first foundation of the reign
